# Test server search keeps stable asset URLs.

md2html -search -http :8394 src &
wait-port :8394

curl -s http://localhost:8394/README.md
stdout 'src="./js/minisearch.min.js"'
stdout 'src="./search-index.js"'
stdout 'src="./js/search.js"'
! stdout 'minisearch.min\.[0-9a-f]\{8\}\.js'

curl -s -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8394/js/search.js
stdout '200'
